guides.favoredWhen: Even. She dodges with E and waits in shroud, so dagger the shroud and all-in when it drops.

keyTips.text: Even skill lane: the E-dodge war decides it.
She stands behind minions at 1 against E: Q-bounce the wave onto her.
She E-dodges your E and E2-interrupts dashes: throw E where her dash ends.

tips.text: Her E2-plus-passive-plus-shroud is the full answer: never stand in the shroud.
Dodge her Q2: the second blast is the damage.
She waits in shroud: dagger the shroud, fight when it drops.
Deny her E1 mark: no mark means no E2 follow.
Shroud daggered plus E-dodge won: the Akali who never hides never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: Even skill lane. She holds Charm for your E, so dagger her from angles and roam when she cannot follow.

keyTips.text: Even skill lane: the Charm-on-E moment decides everything.
Her Q runs about {cd:55:Q}: trade between cooldowns.
She plays the lane slowly and holds Charm defensively: dictate the pace, do not wait.

tips.text: After E to a dagger, expect immediate Charm: keep moving or Shunpo out.
She avoids daggers: place them on her, not near her.
Post-6 she shoves to pin you: shove back and roam first.
Her Charm gets patient when behind: ahead means bait before committing.
Daggers placed plus roams taken: the Ahri who never holds you never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: She keeps E for your engages and punishes daggers. Bait E, then go.

keyTips.text: She keeps E, especially after 6, to break trades and cancel your R: the stun is the lane.
She refuses daggers: place them where she stands, not where she will be.
Your level 2 and 6 are the windows: force them.

tips.text: Outside your windows you are weak: concede, then strike at 2 and 6.
Your roams are the pressure: shove and leave when she must answer.
Do not get locked in: her lead comes from pinning your roams.
Bait her E before R: no scatter means free Death Lotus.
E baited plus roams taken: the Syndra who never pins you never wins.

sources.author: Trisend3
sources.rankClaim: Challenger (title and profile badge) · Syndra main

guides.favoredWhen: Zed-favoured. Daggers decide it, so place them where his shadows are not, and never Shunpo first.

keyTips.text: Zed-favoured: his poke and R answer outscale your engages.
He predicts Shunpo with Q: jump where his shurikens are not.
Do not R first unless it kills: his R answers yours and he Ws away.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: Your early all-in is the window: he respects it, so use it.
Dodge his Qs: the prediction only works if you oblige.
Force the melee: his plan is range, yours is daggers at feet.
His W-away answers your R: R only when shadows are spent.
Death Mark lands him behind you: Shunpo behind yourself when he ults.
Daggers placed plus R held: the Zed who never predicts you never wins.

keyTips.text: Guard health at level 1 outside opponent attack and spell range; it stays her weakest stage.
Roam from level 6 into other lanes and the jungle, since pre-6 kill and reset odds run lower.
Enter late fights only after most enemy crowd control is spent, since control shuts her down fast.

tips.text: Watch for invades pre-lane and note which lane leashes the enemy jungler to predict their path.
Against an early-arriving jungler side, ward it around 2:30 to 3:00 and play toward the other side.
Rush level 2 for E; the level-2 trade works only with a safe way back out.
At level 3, Q the enemy or a minion, E to the dagger, auto once, cast W, then E to an allied minion and out.
Alternate with E first into W and Q, then E to the Q dagger.
Avoid early deaths, since falling behind strangles the snowball.
When opponents leave, pick freezing, shoving for a crash and plates, or following the roam.
Farm the side lane after bot rotates mid to keep gold and experience flowing instead of sharing mid waves.
Rotate back the moment the team starts fighting; otherwise keep farming sides and building items.
Past six Dark Seal stacks and a first item, upgrade to Mejai's while ahead to sharpen the snowball.
Group at Dragon and other majors, where takedowns feed resets that help close games.
Chain fights through the passive, which cuts remaining cooldowns after damaged champions die.
Route through picked-up daggers so each slash damages nearby enemies while repositioning.
Stay patient at objectives and never force an early engage that strands the team in a 4v5.

itemization.text: Take Electrocute for short lane trades and burst, Dark Harvest as the alternative, and Conqueror for longer fights and teamfights.
Pair Sudden Impact with dashes, Grisly Mementos for shorter trinket cooldown, and Relentless Hunter for post-takedown lane moves.
Add Triumph and Coup de Grace for survival and low-health finishes through reset chains.
Start Second Wind with Doran's Shield into lane poke, plus Overgrowth for scaling health.
Display Lich Bane, Spellslinger's Shoes, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Zhonya's Hourglass, and Void Staff on the Electrocute page with Flash and Ignite.
Take Hextech Gunblade and Gluttonous Greaves into Nashor's Tooth, Zhonya's Hourglass, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, and Void Staff as the alternate item set.
